Translate.cfg_language_desc: Change the language of this plugin's F12 config menu and in-raid notifications. Restart the game for the F12 menu to update.
Translate.cfg_enable_buffer_desc: Adds a confirmation buffer to exfiltration points: after entering the zone, the extraction countdown does not start immediately. Hold the interact key to start the buffer countdown; release to cancel; when it finishes, the point opens (same interaction as transit points).
Translate.cfg_buffer_seconds_desc: Buffer countdown duration in seconds. After holding the interact key the countdown runs; when it finishes the exfiltration point opens and the normal ExfiltrationTime extraction countdown starts.
Translate.cfg_enable_always_open_desc: Exfiltration points never fail by chance (RollChance always passes) - never set to NotPresent by probability.
Translate.cfg_enable_cross_faction_desc: PMC and SCAV can use all exfiltration points (InfiltrationMatch always passes) - cross-faction access to Scav/PMC exits.
Translate.cfg_enable_flare_hint_desc: Shows a notification when a flare is successfully received inside a flare zone (type matches and fired inside the zone).
Translate.exfil_enter_hint: Hold the interact key to start exfiltration
Translate.exfil_flare_success_notify: Flare activated - exfiltration point is now passable!
